harness.whatItDid: Moved between recon tools on its own against a Japanese tech firm and an East Asian security company. Google listed it among frameworks abused in incident response in October, then described what it had seen of HexStrike as experimentation in November. Acronis found it installed as an MCP tool server on a lone operator's attack node and wired into every agent that needed it; the report ties no breach to it.

uses.quote: Hexstrike was utilized alongside the Graphiti memory system, a temporal knowledge graph, to maintain a persistent state of the attack surface, allowing the agent to autonomously pivot between tools like subfinder and httpx based on its internal reasoning.
